newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Eight die as Nigerians clash with bows and arrows.
newsitem.headline: Eight die as Nigerians clash with bows and arrows.

text.p: Eight people were killed at a central Nigerian village when two communities clashed with bows and arrows over a traditional ceremony, local newspapers said on Thursday.

The independent Guardian newspaper said a number of houses were also burnt at the village of Changai after members of the Panyam community attacked a ceremony being held to install a new local leader of the Gindiri people on Monday.
Other newspapers which carried the report said an unspecified number of wounded had been taken to hospital.
Military administrator of the local Plateau State, Colonel Habibu Shaibu, warned after the clash that traditional rulers would be punished if violence breaks out in their domains .
Ethnic and community disturbances are not uncommon in Nigeria, Africa's most populous nation with over 100 million people and 250 ethnic groups.
